classification.source: NSE Indices Industry Classification · four-tier company classification
classification.sector_taxonomy: NSDL FPI 22-sector names; NSDL cites BSE Industry Classification under the common BSE–NSE structure
classification.note: Verified rows are supported by the seven separately verified original watchlist mappings or official NSE MarketLens CSV company rows. For MarketLens rows, the Sector industry label is crosswalked to the NSDL FPI 22-sector taxonomy using the NSE Indices Industry Classification Structure; the Sub Sector macro-economic label must independently agree. Duplicate, missing, unrecognised or macro-inconsistent rows remain pending. MarketLens rows are not represented as independently audited BSE company-level confirmations. Eleven additional company rows from the 14-Nov-2026 MarketLens screener data were crosswalked and macro-sector checked: FORCEMOT, TATAELXSI, DATAPATTNS, AMBER, CUB, NBCC, CAMS, KFINTECH, PGEL, KPITTECH and CROMPTON. Two previously pending MarketLens labels were verified against the official NSE Indices hierarchy: Fertilizers & Agrochemicals → Chemicals (PIIND; Commodities macro) and IT - Services → Information Technology (SAGILITY; Information Technology macro). KAYNES remains pending until its exact company-level MarketLens row is verified. The official hierarchy crosswalk now includes Industrial Manufacturing → Capital Goods, but this sector path alone does not prove KAYNES's company classification. Additional company-level MarketLens rows supplied on 14-Nov-2026 were exact-matched against the current 218-symbol F&O universe; 65 new pending symbols passed the industry-to-FPI-sector crosswalk and independent macro-sector check. Rows with blank/unrecognised or macro-inconsistent labels remain pending.
